subject: general
question: If the speeds of a train in 10 successive hours are a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅, a₆, a₇, a₈, a₉, and a₁₀, then the average speed of the train is:

options.text: median of a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅, a₆, a₇, a₈, a₉, and a₁₀
geometric mean of a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅, a₆, a₇, a₈, a₉, and a₁₀
harmonic mean of a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅, a₆, a₇, a₈, a₉, and a₁₀
arithmetic mean of a₁, a₂, a₃, a₄, a₅, a₆, a₇, a₈, a₉, and a₁₀

solution:
**GIVEN:**

Speeds of a train in 10 successive hours = a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8, a9, and a10.

**FORMULA USED:**

Average speed = (Total Distance / Total time)

**SOLUTIONS** :

Distance = Speed ×Time

⇒ d₁ = a₁ × 1 = a₁

⇒ d₂ = a2 × 1 = a₂

⇒ d3= a3 × 1 = a3

⇒ d4 = a4 × 1 = a4

⇒ d5 = a5 × 1 = a5

⇒ d6 = a6 × 1 = a6

⇒ d7 = a7 × 1 = a₇

⇒ d8 = a8 × 1 = a₈

⇒ d9 = a9 × 1 = a9

⇒ d10 = a10 × 1 = a₁₀

⇒ Average speed = (a₁ + a₂ + a₃ + a₄ + a₅ + a₆ + a₇ + a₈ + a₉ + a₁₀) / 10

⇒ So, it is clear that the average speed of the train is the airthmetic mean of a1, a2, a3, a4, a5, a6, a7, a8, a9, and a10

Hence option 4 is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__

Arithmetic mean is the ratio of the sum of all observations to the total number of observations.
